title: Minimum Cover Window
description: Given two lowercase strings S and T, find the shortest contiguous fragment of S that contains every character of T with at least the required frequency. If no such fragment exists, print -1.
constraints: 1 <= |S|, |T| <= 100000; both strings contain only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: First line: S. Second line: T.
outputFormat: Print the shortest covering fragment. If multiple fragments have the same length, print the leftmost one. Print -1 if no covering fragment exists.
hints: Maintain character frequencies inside a sliding window and shrink it whenever all required characters are covered.

examples.explanation: banc contains a, b and c and is the shortest covering fragment.
The required characters cannot all be found in the first string.
